verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe spawning multiple coordinated agents, running long-running/background tasks, scheduling, and parallel cloud sessions (docs-6/34/14/26/8/13/18), directly matching the 'fleets working for hours/days' story. However, community reports describe unreliable self-verification, degrading quality over extended sessions, and repeated failures when left to work autonomously (comm-16, comm-17, comm-19, comm-20), casting doubt on how well this works unsupervised over long horizons.
